item.title: The elements that can never win, part 1: the monotonic deque
item.description: Say you’re keeping track of the biggest number in the last three, and a 5 arrives. Behind it in the window sit a -1 and a -3. Can either of them ever be the biggest number again? No. The 5 is bigger than both of them, and it arrived after them, so it stays in the window longer than they do. Every future window that contains the -1 also contains the 5.
